title: [MTR4]Wuzhou Bus
description: This package is an MTR extension add-on that adds the real-life "Wuzhou Bus" route 3 bus to the game, which can operate on your saved bus routes
body: This resource package is an additional package for the module "MTR" and can only be used in versions above MTR 4.0\nThis package has added the real "Wuzhou Bus" No. 3 bus in the game, which can operate on your saved bus routes\nBug/Suggestions exchange group: 955740177 I wish you a pleasant trip!
